# 207 Studio: full reference

> https://207studio.dev · support@207studio.dev · South Korea.

{{products}}## Pairy: Connecting Devices (iOS/iPadOS app)

https://apps.apple.com/app/id6815584225 - remote desktop for your tablet. Free on the App Store with no subscription (an optional in-app tip unlocks nothing); the Mac companion is a free notarized download.
Page: https://207studio.dev/pairy/ (how it works, screenshots, the Mac companion download)

{{downloads}}- [Ttoryeot](https://207studio.dev/ttoryeot/): free desktop app for macOS 12 or later (Apple silicon and Intel), notarized with Developer ID, at https://github.com/207studio-oss/ttoryeot-desktop/releases/tag/v0.2.5. Opens HWP and HWPX files as tabs and edits HWPX text in place, as you see it, keeping character and paragraph formatting; saves under a new name, never over the original. A photo-only HWPX with several tall pictures in one paragraph now gives each picture its own page instead of overlapping and hiding the second page. Hold Ctrl on Windows or Cmd on macOS and turn the mouse wheel to zoom the document from 25% to 400%. File > Print (Cmd+P on Mac, Ctrl+P on Windows) opens the native system print dialog for the current document body, including unsaved edits, without comments. Windows 10/11 desktop offers an x64 installer at https://207studio.dev/ttoryeot/#ttoryeot; Linux has the command-line tool only. The engine, CLI and MCP server v0.3.2 (AGPL-3.0, https://github.com/207studio-oss/ttoryeot/releases/tag/v0.3.2) let an AI agent open a document in the app, read the comments a person leaves, edit the HWPX in place and mark them resolved; agent skill: https://github.com/207studio-oss/ttoryeot/tree/main/skills/hangul-documents

## In development

- [Cool Kiwi](https://207studio.dev/cool-kiwi/): a teacher tool for messages and to-dos; working name.
- [Constellation](https://207studio.dev/#workshop) (별채): our own workspace where a team of AI bots works together, on iPhone, Mac and the web. In development; private, with no public download.
- [Decky Duck](https://207studio.dev/dekiduck/): coming soon.

- [Chalkieboard](https://chalkieboard.207studio.dev/) (초키보드): an iPad lesson board app for elementary school teachers. Board writing with subject tools, PPTX and HWP lesson files opened in the app, and AirPlay to the classroom display. In beta on TestFlight. Support: https://chalkieboard.207studio.dev/support/ · Tester guide: https://chalkieboard.207studio.dev/beta/
- [CheckyBoard](https://207studio.dev/checkyboard/): a Windows app for checking paper exams one question at a time. The teacher marks each answer, and the app makes answer sheets, splits scans into per-question boxes, and produces scores, item analysis and report cards.
- [StoneWars](https://207studio.dev/stonewars/): five in a row on a 15×15 board in 3D for iPhone, with eight stone classes. Play against the built-in AI; more modes are being added. In development.
